description: This file implements the feature for creating a new article, including data validation, command handling, and database interactions within an ASP.NET Core application following CQRS pattern.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains nested classes and logic for creating an article such as validation, command, handler, and data structures.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object for article information, including title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring that article data fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Command object encapsulating the article data to be created, implementing IRequest returning an ArticleEnvelope.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class for the Command, validating the embedded ArticleData.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the logic for creating an article, including database operations and associating tags.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the creation of an article, managing database saves and returning the created article wrapped in an envelope.
